messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert: elevated 5xxs detected for canary rollout release-2026-03 on service infer-ws (threshold breach). Pager fired.
mel: saw the pager. 5xxs started ~45s after traffic hit 12% canary. throwing up 503/504. tagging @raj @sam @lina
raj: oncall ack. pulling metrics dashboard now. which regions?
mel: spike in us-west-2 first, then eu-west-1. sample traces show connection resets to backend processes.
sam: can you paste a few logs?
mel: logs below:
```
2026-03-15T15:12:01Z infer-ws-canary-2 runtime ERROR: serve request failed err="write: broken pipe" id=ctx-9b3f
2026-03-15T15:12:02Z router warn 503 "backend overload" route=/v1/generate key=sk-prod-8Axx
2026-03-15T15:12:03Z healthcheck probe FAIL /healthz status=503
```
mel: health probes flapping: 3 probes failed in 90s.
raj: abort criteria doc: 5xx >0.4% for 3m OR probe fail >50% canary pods. both conditions met. recommend immediate abort + drain.
sam: agree. prepping kill-switch flip. command: `redwoodctl featureflag set release-2026-03.abort true --env=prod`
mel: also stop routing to canary pool: `redwoodctl routing set --service=infer-ws --pool=canary --weight=0 --env=prod`
deploy-bot: COMMAND: redwoodctl featureflag set release-2026-03.abort true --env=prod
deploy-bot: RESULT: ok - flag set and broadcasted to routing layer
deploy-bot: COMMAND: redwoodctl routing set --service=infer-ws --pool=canary --weight=0 --env=prod
lina: confirmed LB drained canary instances in us-west-2. eu-west-1 draining now.
zack: noting that this rollout included a kv-cache eviction tuning patch (PR #4521). could be related. filing note.
taylor: support: incoming tickets show gen requests returning 5xx for ~10-15 users, most low-volume. drafting status update "Degraded: generation requests intermittently failing". need approval to post.
mel: initiating rollback to stable variant release-2026-02. sam, can you kick rollback?
sam: running `redwoodctl rollout rollback --id=release-2026-03 --to=release-2026-02 --env=prod --reason="canary abort 5xx"`
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK START: release-2026-03 -> release-2026-02; est 5m
raj: keep an eye on metrics during rollback. also enable extra sampling on failed requests (trace-level).
mel: sampling enabled. 5xx rate starting to drop. current 5xx_rate=0.18% (1m)
lina: rollback finished in us-west-2. eu-west-1 finished. global rollback complete.
mel: running smoke: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returns 200 and streaming looks good.
raj: good. support post live?
taylor: posted status page message and emailed affected customers (corepay, merchant-x). replies minimal, most back to normal.
zack: created a ticket to revert kv-cache eviction tweak and run isolated perf tests. assigned to eng-ml.
sam: suggest adding a pre-rollout synthetic load test step and tighten canary thresholds for infer-ws. raising changelist.
mel: creating incident page and timeline, adding links to logs, rollout runbook, and PRs.
raj: postmortem owners: sam (rollback timeline + automation), zack (root cause investigation kv-cache), mel (communication + timeline), taylor (customer comms). target draft in 48h.
mel: handing incident to @raj for follow-up. I'll stay around for any questions during handoff. :thumbsup:
raj: taking it. thanks all for quick response. adding follow-up tasks to next oncall rotation.
